content: Switch translation layer to user's direct Gemini API key (gemini-2.5-flash)
Auth backend: users/sessions/credentials, Argon2id passwords (min 8), HttpOnly session cookie, /api/auth/* routes
Passkeys: one-tap discoverable registration + authentication, RP ID derived from request host
Login/Register page + Account page + auth context
Gate admin settings behind admin login; favourites synced/merged to the account
Mobile header: hamburger right; drawer slides down from top; login/register (or email+logout) at bottom
Compact language/currency toggles; BGN removed; body-type row removed; chassis-condition label
Fix Back button losing all filters (search state now mirrored in the URL)
Fix search hanging: rate-limit waits no longer block web requests (only the offline warm-up is patient)
Full translation warm-up - BLOCKED: Gemini key is heavily rate limited, only ~2,985 of ~8,600 phrases cached
Send enquiry (Прати запитване) on car detail page with guest + logged-in options - NOT STARTED
Track my vehicle (Maersk + MarineTraffic) - NOT STARTED, needs API credentials from user
